title: ADAPTING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS TO MITIGATE SKIN TONE BIASES IN CLINICAL DERMATOLOGY TASKS: A MIXED-METHODS STUDY

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (diagnostic accuracy, informativity, physician utility, and patient utility) and calculating fairness metrics (such as demographic parity, equalized odds, true positive rate, and false positive rate) across the six Fitzpatrick skin types using a balanced subset of annotated skin disease images from the SCIN dataset.
